newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westfield cautious on Asian expansion.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westfield cautious on Asian expansion.

text.p: Shopping centre operator Westfield Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it was cautious on expansion in Asia, but had targetted Malaysia and Indonesia as areas of initial expansion.
"There are a number of opportunities that we are investigating in the Asian marketplace. It is sometning we are going to be cautious about," managing director David Lowy told the annual meeting.
Lowy added it took Westfield 20 years to build its U.S. business, which has a majority interest in Centermark Properties Inc and which holds A$2.2 billion worth of assets in the U.S.
Westfield's main Asian asset is a shopping centre development in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Lowy said Kuala Lumpur was attracting a lot of interest from around the world.
A number of opportunities had been brought to Westfield in the Asian region and they were investigating these opportunities, he said.
"If they meet our criteria and we can get comfortable with the long term prospects of those opportunitioes then certainly we'll take them," Lowy said.
Lowy said Westfield did not have any targetted amount of money or growth projection for Asia.
